text: dsh-translator 是面向 DSH Web 的文本翻译插件。它在界面提供划词浮动按钮和独立输入面板，并通过 Host 路由请求翻译。用户可以选择免费公共翻译接口或 harness 已配置的大模型，查看译文与词典信息，并用面板指定目标语言和回看近期结果。适合阅读外语内容或快速查询词义；免费接口无需 API Key，模型引擎沿用现有模型配置。

dsh-translator adds translation to DSH Web with a floating selection button and an input panel. It uses public endpoints or the harness model, displays translations and dictionary details, and keeps recent results. Free endpoints need no API key; model translation uses existing settings.
想在 DSH 网页里选中一段文字后直接看到翻译。
I want to paste text into a small DSH panel and translate it.
dsh-translator 的功能「划词翻译」：选中页面文字后点击浮动翻译按钮，插件请求译文并显示翻译卡片；短词还可附带词典信息。
dsh-translator 的功能「独立输入翻译面板」：点击面板按钮后输入或粘贴文本，可选择目标语言并提交翻译；面板还可显示近期结果。
dsh-translator 使用免费 API 引擎时，会把待翻译文本发送给所选公共翻译服务；该引擎不需要 API Key。

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · dsh-translator：> **Enhanced fork of [`nicearrack/dsh-translator`](https://github.com/nicearrack/dsh-translator)**, based on upstream `v0.4.3`.
> Adds a **standalone input panel** (translate typed/pasted text, no selection needed), **Google Translate**
> as the first keyless provider, and a **dictionary** layer (POS groups, pinyin/IPA, bilingual examples)
> rendered under the translation.
> Everything else is upstream's — see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the exact diff and
> [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for provenance, verification and how to sync with upstream.

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · dsh-translator：- **Free API** (default) — public translation endpoints. No account, no key, nothing to configure.
- **Model** — the harness's own LLM. Your text stays inside the model pipeline you already configured.

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · Install：On the DSH **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin** and give either the npm package name or the GitHub address:

```
@tuweizhi/dsh-translator
https://github.com/TuWeiZhi/dsh-translator
```

To remove it later, uninstall it from that same page.

To update, uninstall it and add it again — the npm package name and the GitHub address both resolve to the latest release. The new version takes effect once DSH restarts.

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · From the plugin market：DSH ships no central store: the **Discover** tab only lists index sources you add yourself. One index lists both of my plugins:

1. Plugins page → **Experimental plugins** → **More** → enable **Custom plugin market** (a DSH bundle, off by default)
2. **Discover** → **Index sources** → add
   `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TuWeiZhi/dsh-plugins-index/main/index.json`
3. Pick the plugin in **Discover** and install
@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · From the plugin market：Index source: [TuWeiZhi/dsh-plugins-index](https://github.com/TuWeiZhi/dsh-plugins-index).

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · Usage：Select text → click the floating **translate** button → the translation card appears. Drag the card by its header, or pin it so it can't be dismissed by accident. Click the translation (or the source text, or an error message) to copy it.

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · Features：- Select text anywhere; the button follows the selection and adapts to light/dark. A touch or pen selection raises it too, and a selection that wraps lines anchors the button at the point it ended rather than at the whole block
- Direction is automatic: text in your **primary language** becomes English, anything else becomes your primary language. Primary language: 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский
- Settings sit on the plugin's own page. Picking the **Free API** engine shows just the primary language, the service and the timeout; picking **Model** swaps in the model controls. Changes apply to the next translation, with no restart
- The card's footer names what answered — the endpoint for Free API, the model for Model — and marks a reused answer
- Copy, drag and pin. One card at a time — but a card you pin stays where you put it, still finishing if it was mid-translation, while you translate something else
- Asking for the same passage again is answered from a short-lived cache, so it costs one request, not two. **Retry** deliberately ignores the cache and asks again
- A translation that came back unchanged is labelled as untranslated inst

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · The free API engine：Public endpoints run by Tencent, Microsoft, Volcengine and MyMemory. None of them needs registration, an API key or a token. Requests go out from the DSH host process rather than the browser, so there is no CORS negotiation and no cookie is sent. Automatic mode walks the chain and benches a failing provider with a backoff that starts at 30 seconds and caps at five minutes; any one page may make 60 requests a minute, after which the card asks you to wait a moment.

Two things worth knowing:

@tuweizhi/dsh-translator README · The free API engine：- These are **undocumented web endpoints, not official APIs**. They carry no SLA and can change without notice — which is why the chain exists. If every one of them is down, the card says so and points at the **Model** engine.
- **Your selected text leaves the machine** and goes to whichever provider answers. The first free-engine translation a browser performs says so in the card, once; after that it is not shown again. If that is not acceptable, use the **Model** engine.
